disposition_reason: Randomized trial documenting oral bismuth subsalicylate dosing (1,048 mg twice daily) within quadruple H. pylori therapy and adverse-event rates of the combined regimen; no bismuth measured.

study.method: 13C-urea breath test for eradication; questionnaire for adverse events; bismuth not measured

regulatory_or_exposure: Oral bismuth subsalicylate 1,048 mg twice daily for 7 or 14 days within quadruple H. pylori therapy (p. 2860).
non_numeric_findings: Adding L. reuteri lowered nausea and vomiting, abdominal discomfort and bitter taste in the 14-day arms (Table 4, p. 2862).
Black stool is named as a common adverse event that should not be mistaken for upper gastrointestinal bleeding (pp. 2861 to 2862).
